negative.name: Impaired
negative.description: All attacks rolled by the target have disadvantage.

negative.name: Exposed
negative.description: All attack rolls against the target have advantage.

negative.name: Corroded
negative.description: Progresses through repeated applications: 1st -5 AC, 2nd PA halved, 3rd MA halved. Each lasts 1 round. Further applications extend existing effects in order. Requires 3 applications per round to maintain full effect.

negative.name: Rooted
negative.description: Movement speed reduced to 0. Other movement types and teleportation still allowed.

negative.name: Snared
negative.description: All movement reduced to 0. Cannot be teleported or repositioned (except planar movement).

negative.name: Disarmed
negative.description: Cannot perform weapon or natural attacks.

negative.name: Poisoned
negative.description: Disadvantage on saving throws and skill checks.

negative.name: Paralyzed
negative.description: Snared, disarmed, exposed, and poisoned.

negative.name: Envenomed
negative.description: Takes X poison damage at the start of each turn. Multiple independent instances.

negative.name: Burning
negative.description: Takes X fire damage at the start of each turn. Multiple independent instances.

negative.name: Wounded
negative.description: Takes X additional damage from direct attacks and spells. Multiple independent instances.

negative.name: Taunted
negative.description: Must target the taunter with all offensive abilities. AoE must include the taunter.

negative.name: Prone
negative.description: Melee attacks have advantage against target. Ranged attacks have disadvantage (medium or smaller). Standing up costs 2 AP. Each additional application increases stand cost by 2. Can spend AP across multiple turns. Cannot perform actions before standing.

negative.name: Dazed
negative.description: AP recovery is halved.

negative.name: Stunned
negative.description: Cannot act. AP recovery is paused. Also exposed and poisoned.

negative.name: Silenced
negative.description: Cannot speak or cast spells with verbal components.

negative.name: Terrified
negative.description: Must move away from the source. If unable, does nothing. Ends if the source is no longer visible.

negative.name: Petrified
negative.description: Cannot act. AP recovery paused. Immune to all damage and effects except true damage. Also exposed and poisoned.

negative.name: Frozen
negative.description: Cannot act. AP recovery paused. Immune to all damage and effects. Also exposed and poisoned. May be applied to willing allies intentionally.

negative.name: Sleeping
negative.description: Cannot act. Ends if the target takes damage or is harmed.

negative.name: Blinded
negative.description: Cannot see. Attacks have disadvantage. Attacks against target have advantage. Disadvantage on DEX saving throws. Cannot perform attacks of opportunity. Range limited to 15ft unless special senses apply.

negative.name: Mad
negative.description: Treats all creatures as enemies.

negative.name: Charmed
negative.description: Treats the charmer and their allies as allies. Ends if harmed by them.

negative.name: Maimed
negative.description: Healing received is halved.

negative.name: Cursed
negative.description: Cannot benefit from healing.

negative.name: Decaying
negative.description: Healing effects deal damage instead.

negative.name: Ethereal
negative.description: Takes half damage from physical sources and double damage from magical sources.

negative.name: Weakened
negative.description: Damage dealt is halved (before reductions).

negative.name: Suffocating
negative.description: Gains 1 exhaustion stack at the end of each turn.

negative.name: Exhaustion
negative.description: Cumulative exhaustion ladder (Q15/N19): 1 disadvantage on ability checks; 2 speed halved; 3 disadvantage on all rolls; 4 abilities and attacks against the bearer automatically hit; 5 speed 0; 6 death. Stacks persist until removed (no duration); a missed 8-hour rest grants stacks (N19). Suffocating applies 1 stack per turn-end; other sources are DM bookkeeping. Eniyans are immune (racial passive).

negative.name: Sleep
negative.description: Falls asleep. Cannot act. Ends if the target takes damage or is harmed. Distinct from Sleeping in that it is magically induced.

negative.name: Crystallised
negative.description: Encased in crystal. Cannot act. Immune to all damage and effects. Similar to frozen but specifically from crystallisation magic.

negative.name: Sorrow
negative.description: Overwhelmed by grief. Disadvantage on all attack rolls and saving throws. Imposed by bard songs of woe.

negative.name: Caged
negative.description: Trapped in an area and cannot leave. Attacks against the trapped creature have disadvantage.

negative.name: Difficult Terrain
negative.description: Area effect. Movement speed is halved while traversing the affected area.

negative.name: Obscured Vision
negative.description: Area effect. Ranged attacks through the area have disadvantage.

negative.name: Pushback
negative.description: Target is pushed away from the source by a set distance.

negative.name: Conditional Invisibility
negative.description: Target cannot be seen by certain creatures. Ends when the invisible creature takes a hostile action.

negative.name: Disadvantage (Next Attack)
negative.description: The target has disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability requiring an attack roll.

negative.name: Disadvantage (All Attacks)
negative.description: The target has disadvantage on all attack rolls for the duration.

negative.name: Disadvantage (Attacks Against Target)
negative.description: All enemies have disadvantage on attacks against the protected target for the duration.

negative.name: Stun on Retaliation
negative.description: When the affected creature is attacked, the attacker must save or be stunned.

negative.name: WILL Save Reduction
negative.description: The target's WILL saving throws are reduced by a set value.

positive.name: Block
positive.description: Negates the next X damage instances that would reduce HP.

positive.name: Perseverance
positive.description: First time HP would drop to 0, remains at 1.

positive.name: Regenerating
positive.description: Heals X at the end of each turn.

positive.name: Retaliation
positive.description: Melee attackers take X damage (ignores armor).

positive.name: Empowered
positive.description: One damage instance per ability gains +X damage.

positive.name: Warded
positive.description: Negates incoming negative effects, consuming 1 stack per negation.

positive.name: Death Resist
positive.description: Damage cannot reduce HP below 1 during your turn.

positive.name: Haste
positive.description: +1 AP recovery and +10 movement speed. Removes slow effects.

positive.name: Sharp
positive.description: Advantage on attack rolls until the end of the creature's next turn.

positive.name: Temporary HP
positive.description: Gains X temporary HP. Damage reduces temporary HP before actual HP. Does not stack — higher value replaces lower.

positive.name: Attack Bonus
positive.description: Gains +X to attack rolls (physical and magical) for the duration.

positive.name: Attack Bonus (+5)
positive.description: Gains +5 to all attack rolls for the duration. From Hail the Champions.

positive.name: Damage Bonus
positive.description: Gains +X to all direct damage rolls for the duration.

positive.name: AC Bonus
positive.description: Gains +X AC. If AC is still below 20 after increase, gains +2 instead of +1.

positive.name: Movement Speed Bonus
positive.description: Movement speed increased by X for the rest of the creature's turn.

positive.name: AP Bonus
positive.description: Starting AP and AP recovery increased by 1.

positive.name: Save Bonus
positive.description: Saving throws and ability checks increased by X.

positive.name: Spell DC Bonus
positive.description: When casting a spell requiring a save, the DC is increased by X.

positive.name: Critical Chance Bonus
positive.description: Critical hit chance increased by X (dice values). E.g. +2 means crit on 18-20 instead of 20.

positive.name: Critical Chance (+5)
positive.description: Critical hit chance increased by 5 (25%). Crit on 15-20. From Hail the Champions.

positive.name: Mana Cost Reduction
positive.description: Mana cost of spells reduced by X. Cannot reduce below 0.

positive.name: Reduced Weapon AP Cost
positive.description: Weapon attacks cost X less AP. If dual wielding, the reduction applies only to attacks using both weapons.

positive.name: Physical Resistance
positive.description: Resistant to physical damage. If vulnerable to a physical type, vulnerability is removed and treated as normal.

positive.name: Magic Shield
positive.description: Absorbs up to X damage from magical sources before breaking. Physical and true damage bypass it.

positive.name: Physical Shield
positive.description: Absorbs up to X damage from physical sources before breaking. Magical and true damage bypass it.

positive.name: Charm Immunity
positive.description: The first mind-altering or charm effect is nullified. Consumed on use.

positive.name: Reroll Ones
positive.description: When rolling a 1 on any die, reroll and use the new result. Applies to all dice. Cannot be doubled.

positive.name: Telepathy
positive.description: Can communicate telepathically without speaking.

positive.name: No Verbal Components
positive.description: Spells and abilities no longer require verbal components.

positive.name: Disarm Immunity
positive.description: Cannot be disarmed.

positive.name: Grapple Advantage
positive.description: Advantage on saves against being grappled, shoved, or snared.

positive.name: Ignore Resistance/Vulnerability
positive.description: Physical weapon damage ignores resistances and vulnerabilities (not immunities, frail, or absorptions). Cannot be doubled.

positive.name: Damage Cap
positive.description: Cannot take more than X% of max HP as damage in a round. Attacks exceeding the cap deal no damage. Cannot be doubled.

positive.name: Advantage (Allies)
positive.description: Allies within the area have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

positive.name: Cleanse One Effect
positive.description: Removes one negative effect from the target (poison, slow, prone, or charm).

positive.name: Radiant Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range deal bonus light damage equal to spell modifier on attack rolls.

positive.name: Precision Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range gain +1 to attack rolls. Each miss increases bonus by +1, resets to +1 after a hit.

positive.name: Swarm-Killer Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range are not affected by flanks or pack-tactics. Attacks against them cannot have advantage.

positive.name: Legion Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range have advantage on attack rolls against enemies if they and another ally are within melee range of the foe.

positive.name: Vampiric Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range heal for 20% of damage dealt with single-target attacks and spells.

positive.name: Predator Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range score critical hits when hitting a stunned or prone enemy.

positive.name: Fearless Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range are immune to terrified. When an attempt to terrify is made, they become enraged for 1 turn (max dice damage).

positive.name: Purity Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range are resistant to light damage and immune to possession/enthrallment. No effect on already possessed/enthralled.

positive.name: Grounded Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range are immune to teleportation, banishing, and instant-kill effects.

positive.name: Blessed Aura
positive.description: Aura. Allies in range roll d100 each time they take damage. On 85 or higher, they take no damage.

positive.name: Concentrating
positive.description: Maintaining concentration on a spell (marker, M4-C/Q27). Taking damage forces a WILL saving throw (DC = 5 + attacker's might) or the spell ends. Starting another concentration spell immediately ends this one. Ending it willingly during your turn is free.

positive.name: Channeling
positive.description: Channeling a spell (marker, M4-C/Q27) — fully focused and unable to perform actions until the channel ends. Taking damage forces a WILL saving throw (DC = 5 + attacker's might) or the channel ends. Ending it willingly during your turn is free.
